summary: Learn effective Risk Governance and Credit Risk Management techniques in our expert-led training course. Equip yourself for success in the financial sector.
lede: Credit risk management training prepares finance and risk professionals to assess lending exposure and oversee portfolio risk. Participants practice measuring default and recovery risk, analyzing portfolio concentration, and modeling expected credit losses under macroeconomic scenarios, while developing risk governance and executive reporting capabilities.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced finance and risk professionals who are responsible for the integrity of lending portfolios and the implementation of institutional risk frameworks.
modules: Risk Governance and the Basel IV Landscape
Quantitative Credit Risk Measurement and Modeling
Advanced Credit Assessment and Scoring Systems
Modern Pressures: ESG and Digital Transformation
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in credit analysis, risk management, or corporate banking. A working knowledge of basic financial accounting and familiarity with the Basel III framework is required. No advanced programming skills are necessary, though proficiency in Microsoft Excel for financial modeling is essential.
